A complete list of free resource sites for designers/programmers

Free resources · Quick reference manual · Selected 70+ sites · All free or with free version · Updated April 2026

Making PPTs, writing articles, building public accounts, making videos—finding materials and finding hair loss?

Today, I have compiled all the most commonly used 70+ free resource sites for designers and programmers, covering seven major categories: image libraries, fonts, icons, illustrations, color schemes, design tools, and prototype tools. **Each site has been verified, all free or includes free versions. Recommended to save for future use. **

All site data comes from internet research (April 2026). License agreements may change at any time. Please double-check each site’s latest license terms before commercial use.

1. Top 15 Free Image Libraries

Finding images is the most frequent need. These 15 gallery covers landscapes, people, food, e-commerce, creative scenarios, and more, all free for commercial use.

Station Website Permission Highlights
Unsplash unsplash.com Free for commercial use Over 3 million high-quality art photos, with no ownership requirements
Pexels pexels.com Free for commercial use 3 million+ free high-definition photos and videos, available in 28 languages
Pixabay pixabay.com Free for commercial use 4.5 million+ photos/illustrations/vectors/videos/music
Reshot reshot.com Free for commercial use 25,000+ non-material-like authentic photos, startup style
Burst by Shopify burst.shopify.com Free for commercial use Focused on e-commerce/entrepreneur scenarios, 29,000+ RMB
Gratisography gratisography.com Free for commercial use Photos in quirky/fun/creative styles
NegativeSpace negativespace.co CC0 4700+ CC0 high-definition photos, sorted by label and color
Kaboompics kaboompics.com Free for commercial use 20,000+ lifestyle/indoor/food photos, with built-in color options
StockSnap.io stocksnap.io CC0 High-quality CC0 photos, supports online editing
Life of Pix lifeofpix.com CC0 4500+ landscape/architectural/nature photos
ISO Republic isorepublic.com CC0 6000+ photos and videos, updated daily
Morguefile morguefile.com Free for commercial use 400,000+ free photos, a classic 2006 stock gallery
FreeImages freeimages.com Partially free 300,000+ classic style photos
Nappy nappy.co Free for commercial use Focus on high-quality photos of Black/Brown people
Picjumbo picjumbo.com Free for commercial use 6800+ free photos, strong food/nature/people categories

The three giants of image libraries: Unsplash (the most artistic), Pexels (also rich in videos), and Pixabay (the most comprehensive).

2. Free fonts

Font copyright is a blind spot for many beginners—misuse may lead to legal risks. All fonts provided by the following sites are free for commercial use.

Station Website Explanation Permission
Google Fonts fonts.google.com 1500+ open-source fonts, available in both Chinese and Spanish SIL OFL/Apache
Font Squirrel fontsquirrel.com 100% free commercial font aggregation site All free for commercial use
DaFont dafont.com Tens of thousands of free fonts, decorative, handwritten, and pixel styles Some are free for individuals only
FontSpace fontspace.com 160,000+ free fonts, designer-reviewed Most are free for commercial use
Fontesk fontesk.com High-quality free fonts with strong design sense Each font is licensed independently
1001 Fonts 1001fonts.com Preview paragraph effects and support filtering for commercial use Can be filtered for commercial use
League of Moveable Type theleagueofmoveabletype.com Open source font alliance, extremely high quality SIL OFL
Behance Fonts View page：behance.net · fonts Free font projects uploaded by designers Most are free for commercial use

⚠️ Some fonts on DaFont are free for personal use only; commercial use requires separate confirmation.

3. Free icon library

Creating interfaces, PPTs, and blogs all rely on icons. All support SVG format.

Icon library Explanation Permission
Font Awesome 2000+ free SVG/Web Font icons CC BY 4.0 + MIT
Heroicons Produced by the Tailwind team, 200+ exquisite SVGs MIT
Lucide 800+ icons, supports React/Vue/Angular ISC
Bootstrap Icons 2000+ SVG and Web Font icons MIT
Tabler Icons 5600+ pixels with perfect SVG icons MIT
Phosphor Icons Supports five font weights: Thin, Light, Regular, Thick, and Fill MIT
Ionicons 1300+ icons, three styles: outline, filled, and sharp MIT
Feather Icons 280+ minimalist line icons MIT
Iconoir 1200+ hand-drawn style icons MIT
Boxicons 1500+ modern-style icons CC BY 4.0
Remix Icon 2800+ neutral style system icons Apache 2.0
Simple Icons 3100+ brand logo SVG icons CC0

How to choose an icon library? Use Lucide for general projects; Use Simple Icons for brand logos; Use Bootstrap Icons directly for Bootstrap projects.

4. Free illustration materials

Good illustrations instantly elevate pages. Supports SVG format with customizable colors.

Station Style/Description Permission
unDraw Open-source SVG illustrations, customizable brand colors, unified style Free for commercial use
Stories by Freepik Dynamic/static story illustrations Free (subject to ownership)
DrawKit Modern style SVG illustration collection, modular and combinable Partially free
Humaaans Mixable Character Illustration Component Library (by InVision) CC BY 4.0
Open Peeps Hand-drawn style character illustration library CC0
Blush Design Artists can create and customize colors online Free (subject to ownership)
IRA Design Gradient style illustration component library Free (subject to ownership)
Ouch (Icons8) Multiple styles (flat, 3D, line, etc.) Free (subject to ownership)
Delesign Weekly updates, customizable main color tone Free for commercial use

unDraw is the Unsplash of illustration—completely free, customizable brand colors.

5. Color matching tools

Color schemes are the soul of design. These tools help you quickly generate, browse, and fine-tune color schemes.

Tools Website Features
Coolors coolors.co Spacebar random generation, lock-in fine-tuning, Figma plugin
Adobe Color color.adobe.com Color Wheel/Extraction/Accessibility Check/Trend Exploration
Color Hunt colorhunt.co Manually selected color schemes with one-click replication of color values
ColorDrop colordrop.io Thousands of color options, AI-generated new solutions
Huemint huemint.com AI-driven color schemes generate for brands, websites, and print prints
ColorMagic colormagic.app Generate color schemes from text/images/color values
ColourCode View page：toptal.com · colourcode Mouse movements generate color schemes
SuperColorPalette supercolorpalette.com Adjust hue/saturation/brightness generation

Quick color scheme: Coolors (random spacebar) + Color Hunt (directly copy homework).

6. Online design tools

Don’t want Photoshop? These online tools are more than enough.

Tools Explanation Free plan
Canva A fully functional online design platform integrating templates and AI tools Free basic version
Photopea Browser-side Photoshop, supports PSD/XD/Sketch Free (including ads)
GIMP An open-source image editor with features close to Photoshop Open source and free of charge
Inkscape An open-source vector graphics editor that replaces Illustrator Open source and free of charge
Vectr A free online vector graphics editor suitable for beginners Free of charge
Remove.bg AI cuts out images with one click, removes background in 5 seconds Free of charge: 1 ticket per session
TinyPNG PNG/JPEG lossless compression, reduced by 50-80% Free of 20 tickets per session
Squoosh Google-produced image compression, supports WebP/AVIF Free and open source

7. Prototype/UI tools

Engaged in app design, web prototyping, and prototype demonstrations.

Tools Explanation Free plan
Figma Industry-standard collaborative design platform, UI/UX/prototype Three free items
Penpot An open-source Figma alternative, supports CSS Grid, and can be self-hosted Open source and free of charge
Mockup World Lots of free sample templates (mobile/computer/packaging PSD) Free of charge
Smartmockups Online prototype generator, no PS required Free basic version
Framer Interactive prototyping and website building tools Two free activities

Figma is the industry standard; the free version with three projects is enough for personal use. If you care about privacy and data sovereignty, choose Penpot.

Summary: Only one is selected per category

  • 📸 Gallery: Unsplash — 3 million+ high-quality photos, the best search experience

  • 🔤 Fonts: Google Fonts — 1500+ open-source fonts, zero-cost web embedding

  • 🎯 Icons: Lucide — 800+ exquisite SVG icons, best frame support

  • 🎨 Illustration: unDraw — open-source SVG illustrations with customizable brand colors

  • 🌈 Color Schemes: Coolors — Random spacebar color, Figma plugin integration

  • 🛠️ Design :P hotopea — Browser-based Photoshop, supports PSD format

  • 📐 Prototype: Figma — Industry standard, with the richest plugin ecosystem

70+ free resource sites, covering the entire process from image search to design. **Recommended to save this and use it directly next time you make PPTs, articles, or videos. **
